messages:
Alex: Quick sync — customer triage for the Optimize toolkit. Several customers (ShopLoop, AcmeHealth) asked for concrete recommendations: per-workload quant profiles, per-route batching defaults, and eval-triggered alerting in Console. Can we carve a minimal sprint scope + launch gates?
Priya: SG. I'll consolidate asks into a matrix. One Q: make eval-triggered alerts GA blocker or pilot-only?
Marta: Pilot-only for initial rollout. GA if we can tie alerts to a regression SLO and provide an "ack + rollback" playbook. Otherwise customers expect noise.
Jamie: Proposed prioritization rubric: impact x effort x regulatory/risk. Quick gut: quant recs = high impact (cost delta 30–60%), medium effort. Eval alerts = high impact for trust, but higher infra work.
Sam: Engineering note — we need runtime hooks for KV cache telemetry + a light-weight eval pipeline to avoid re-ingesting full traffic. If we scope to "basic pipeline" (batch eval jobs + alert webhook) we can do ~6 weeks with a 2-eng core.
EvalsBot: Automated: Evals run completed 2026-03-20 18:02 UTC. ShopLoop: 8 failing prompts out of 1.2k. Suggested threshold: 0.5% fail -> create alert. See: https://internal.evals/2378
Alex: Thinking minimal MVP list: 1) Quantization recommendations UI (per-model + workload sample) with opt-in apply, 2) Adaptive batching defaults (per-route override), 3) Eval-triggered alerts (basic thresholding + webhook). Must-haves: docs + canary rollout plan + telemetry.
Priya: Acceptance criteria I'm drafting: - Feature spec + product doc - SDK flags for per-route overrides - Console UI + alert inbox row - Canary + 2-step rollout plan - E2E test for eval-alert -> notification
Marta: Example config for defaults I sketched:
```yaml
optimize:
  batching:
    adaptive: true
    target_p99_ms: 120
    default_batch_size: 32
  caching:
    ttl_default_sec: 7200
    prefix_cache: true
  quant:
    suggest_profiles: true
    safety_checks: [accuracy-regression, latency]
```
Keep defaults conservative for GA.
Jamie: Can we attach a clear rollback criterion for quant suggestions? e.g., accuracy drop > 1% on sampled evals -> auto-revert suggestion.
Sam: Agreed. Also need infra SLOs: eval job latency < 10m and alert delivery < 1m for high-priority customers. Otherwise ops burden skyrockets.
Alex: Timeline ask: can product + eng sign-off by EOD Friday? We'll use that to schedule sprint kickoff.
Priya: I'll send draft timeline + matrix today. Tentative: Sprint 1 (6w): quant UI + basic suggest engine + docs; Sprint 2 (4w): adaptive batching rollout + per-route overrides; Sprint 3 (3w): eval-alert infra + Console inbox.
Sam: From infra: ok if we cut non-essential niceties in sprint 1. Need 2 dedicated ENG weeks from infra team in sprint 2 for rollout hooks.
Marta: Also propose a beta cohort: ShopLoop + AcmeHealth for pilot. Need NDA consents noted.
Alex: Good call. Locking scope for now. @Priya please send the matrix + timeline link in this thread and tag stakeholders for EOD sign-off. :thumbsup:
Priya: Sending draft now -> https://docs.internal/redwood/optimize/triage-matrix (will ping stakeholders).
Jamie: +1 from product.
Sam: +1 from eng-infra.
Marta: +1 on playbook/rollback criteria.
EvalsBot: Reminder: new eval alerts will create tickets in #incidents if threshold crossed and not acknowledged in 24h.
Alex: Thanks team — we'll reconvene after sign-offs.
